newsitem.title: SPAIN: Health debate must be in parliament - Spain's Costa.
newsitem.headline: Health debate must be in parliament - Spain's Costa.

text.p: Health financing decisions must be debated in parliament and agreement cannot be reached outside that body, Spanish Tax Secretary Juan Costa told local radio on Wednesday.
The ruling Popular Party's Catalan allies are pressing for 32 billion pesetas in central government funds for their 1997 regional health budget.
"Items that have to do with health financing have to be debated, have to be analysed and have to be finalised in the heart of that body (parliament)," Costa told Spanish radio.
The national 1997 budget draft must be presented to parliament by month's end and the PP is counting on Catalan support.
